style: Use the attached images ONLY as a STYLE reference for the LINE and the flat playful editorial look — match their bold confident black ink outlines, flat colors with NO gradients and minimal shading, and generous negative space. Do NOT copy their colors. Use instead a flat limited PASTEL palette: mint green #B6E5CF, powder blue #AFC9E8, pale butter yellow #F6E7A8, soft blush pink #F6C6DA, and black, on a PLAIN WHITE background. Draw a brand-new, SIMPLE, uncluttered illustration with one clear subject (not a busy scene).
end: Subject centered with lots of empty white space around it. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions.
